content.short: Hivemapper is a Solana DePIN where drivers earn HONEY for contributing dashcam imagery to a continuously refreshed global map.
content.description: Hivemapper is a decentralized mapping network on Solana that rebuilds street level map data from crowdsourced dashcam footage. Contributors mount a supported dashcam, drive normally, and earn HONEY for the imagery they upload as well as for validating and annotating other contributors' submissions. Because rewards favour freshness over one time coverage, roads get re-driven instead of going stale, which is the weak point of conventional survey fleets. Developers and enterprises burn HONEY to consume the resulting map data.
